english.title: Overtake while approaching controlled area of signal controlled crossing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[rider]_

of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when it or part of it was within the limits of a signal controlled crossing facility controlled area and proceeding towards the

(C)_[equestrian]_
(D)_[signal-controlled pedestrian facility]_
(E)_[toucan]_

crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), caused the vehicle or part of it to pass ahead of the foremost part of

(F)_[a motor vehicle proceeding in the same direction]_
(G)_[a vehicle which was stationary for the purpose of complying with a traffic light signal for controlling vehicular traffic]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 15, part 1 of Schedule 14 of the Traffic Signs Regulation and General Directions 2016, section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes: The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 were repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, these regulations remain in force in relation to Pelican crossings that were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal) by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

No endorsement or disqualification if offence committed in respect of a non-motor vehicle.

6 months
